## Chapter One

Leave it to Lucas





“You know despite what you may think, high school isn’t free young man, we pay a small fortune to ensure you have the privilege of an education, and it is a privilege” William Christian yelled from the kitchen of the small ranch house where he and his son resided. Lucas rolled his eyes; this was not the first time his father had given this speech. “I mean, you could have been one of those kids that had to go into the indentured internship program at thirteen and pray the company trained you in something you could make a living off of” Lucas mouthed as his father spoke the words. He knew the speech all too well. Lucas wrapped the towel tighter around his body and wiped the condensation from the mirror, the byproduct of the extremely hot shower that he had just enjoyed.



“Molly news” Lucas stated at the mirror a small window appearing in the corner as the smart home virtual interface or “Molly” began to collate the day’s news from ANN American News Network, the state sponsored arm of the Department of Public Affairs, it was news but he figured as did most people suspected only about twenty percent truth in there reporting. “Dad, I am not abandoning school, I am just taking a year off before applying for a company sponsorship for college” the young man stated yelling towards the kitchen, though with as small as it house was, he only had to speak softly in the small shoebox in order to be heard clearly.



They had argued this same argument since Friday as soon as he had come home that day from school and announced in all his righteous teenage indignation to his father that he wouldn’t be applying for corporate sponsorship until the first quarter of next year. He had not seen it as a big deal until his father had damn near exploded over his son’s decision.



Shaking his head and staring at himself in the mirror he put a reproachful look on and mouthed his fathers continued tirade, he didn’t need this pressure, with only a week until graduation he had too much to do , he knew dad did it because he cared, but after mom had died three years ago in a laboratory accident , his father had descended further and further into a deep depression, his only mission to protect his son, and the only thing he had succeeded in doing was pushing Lucas away.



His father hovered and was incredibly smothering at a time when Lucas needed space to grow and find out about himself and what he wanted, his father had gone from an asset to an obstacle, he hated to think of him like that, Lucas loved his father, worried about him in fact. But the old man needed to let go, soon Lucas would be out on his own and then who would his father have. Lucas worried what would become of him, but not enough to cancel his plans, he had seen in a friend of his, Simon, what happened when you lived to please your parents, you ended up despising them and he never wanted to despise his father, they were all each other had. Poor Simon spent most of his time trying to piss off his parents even to the point of self-destruction and Lucas had vowed to himself he would never become that person.



As Lucas reflected on Simon and his escapades he glanced over to the mirror where a talking head from ANN was reporting in front of a smoking ruin of a building in some city. “Molly increase volume thirty five percent” he ordered the smart home Virtual Interface or VI for short. Instantly he could hear the mock sorrow in the reporter’s voice. “Twelve people killed in the latest bombing at a food center in Arlington Virginia today, as workers were launching the new work for food program to help feed the impoverished In the city, an unidentified woman walked into the center wearing a suicide vest” he stated with a frown to go with the mock sorrow Lucas thought, shaking his head.

Mister Walker his social economics teacher had ranted about the new program, well as much as anyone could rant against the government and not be accused of being unpatriotic and forced to report to a reeducation center he thought. It wasn’t fair, poor people worked and received a quarter food credit per hour, after like eight hours they could buy a sandwich, it sucked but it was better then nothing he thought. And now some asshole goes and blows themselves up, and for what he thought disdainfully, so they could be a ten second soundbite for this asshat.



Lucas swiped his hand over the playing video, it disappeared, replaced by the ten-day forecast.



He looked himself over in the mirror one last time, his father still railing about his privilege for being raised as the son of a government executive and not appreciating all the advantages that came with. Lucas rolled his eyes, first making sure his father was still in the kitchen and not able to see him he might be petulant, but he definitely wasn’t suicidal he thought. Smiling to himself in the mirror, he could appreciate the good strong chin and platinum blonde hair, the product of good genes he thought, the ocean blue eyes appraised his physique which he did daily, not out of vanity he concluded but to ensure he was normal, as with every teenager Lucas had hangups about his body and looks. At six foot eight inches tall, he towered above most of his class mates and caught the eye of most of the females at his school. He was smart enough to know they liked him, but too ignorant on the ways of women to be able to take advantage of that knowledge.



At the tender age of seventeen girls were still a mystery to him, but one he was determined to conquer. “Dad don’t worry I will apply for the sponsorship, I just need some time to find myself” he yelled to the still grumbling man in the kitchen and to get away from you for a while Lucas thought giving the mirror a guilty wince and banishing the errant thought.



He stepped from the bathroom and into the small kitchen area to find his father sitting at the table with a coffee and a tablet reading the news. The older man looked up with a disapproving glare at his son. Lucas did his best to ignore the look and made himself a simple breakfast of toast and a glass of Milk. “Besides dad, you know even with a sponsorship, I am going to have to live here for the next ten years, I mean once I am out of school, I will only be making half of what I should in order to pay back the company for putting me through college. Stevie has it made, his dad is a VP over at Envirotech and he made enough this bonus to pay for Stevie’s whole semester. Lucas said whistfully and not without a little envie for his friend. William shook his head, noticing that his shirt had become a bit disheveled, he quickly tucked it in around the small gut that had come with age and looked up at his son. “Im sorry, I don’t make enough to pay the costs of what they want for college, even with the raise I am getting later this year it won’t be enough” his father said softly, almost like an apology. Lucas shook his head “I know dad, and its not that, I was just day dreaming, you have taken great care of me, I have no complaints” Lucas said softly to his father, knowing he needed to hear that.

Before the air could grow uncomfortable from the rare sensitive moment the two men were sharing, Lucas rose from the chair putting the piece of toast in his mouth as he quickly adjusted his backpack. “I need to run, or I am going to be late” he said removing the offending piece of toast, now missing a large piece from its end. “I have my presentation today, are you going to be able to make it?” he asked his father hopefully. William smiled at his son “Wouldn’t miss it for the world buddy, ill be there” William said, resolving to organize his schedule so he could attend the presentation since up until that moment of his son reminding him, he had forgotten all about it.



Lucas left the house and walked towards the bus stop as he did every day. Tommy was stood at the base of his driveway looking fidgety and uncomfortable as always, Thomas Reginald fellows was a geeky overweight teen with bottlecoke glasses in a time when most eye issues could be fixed with surgery, he had been fortunate enough to have been born to this neighborhood’s leading power couple, both his mother and father were higher ups in Polyhedron, one of the four corporatations that made up the managing council of the New United States. It meant no one made fun of poor tommy to his face. Lucas and he had been friends since the first day of kindergarten and he smiled as he approached his friend, who looked more uncomfortable the usual. “Hey Lucas um, we should not pass the Robinsons house and take the other way to the bus stop” he said to his friend, trying to sound casual but it came across as anything but.



Lucas stopped and eyed his friend “Whats up Tommy?” he asked and Lucas had known his friend long enough to know when something was up . Tommy, deflating now that he had been discovered seemed to slump a little “My mom said they are coming to get Mrs Robinson, apparently her credit score dropped a hundred points and she is being taken in for questioning” he said looking over his shoulder towards the Robinsons small cookie cutter house, it looked the same as every other house on the block including Lucas’s. As they stared three unmarked black vans pulled up , spilling ten soldiers in unmarked body armor. It didn’t matter that they were not wearing patches or hell even banners stating, “Black Dragon Security” Every knew who they were, they were the black ops bag men the corporation in charge of the Ministry of enforcement. The long arm of the law for the council. They watched as the soldiers stormed the house and a moment later Mrs Robins was escorted out in hand cuffs and a black bag over her head, Lucas and Tommy could hear her protesting loudly about some computer mistake, but that was all they could make out, because with Ruthless efficiently Mrs Robinson was escorted across her small lawn and shoved into one of the waiting vans, and then the vehicle quickly pulled into the street and just like that they were gone.



Lucas wasn’t stupid, he knew when Blake Dragon showed up, you were most likely going to be erased. Both kids had seen it before. One moment you existed and the next, no one talked about you. Lucas Remembered back to Mr. Johnson, he and Mrs Johnson had been a happy couple until one day the black vans had shown up for him, the very next day Lucas had walked over to inquire about her husband, he still remembered the pained tears that ran down her face “There is no Mr. Johnson, there never has been Lucas, now please go away” she had said, the pain pouring from eyes as she quickly shut the door in her face.



Lucas didn’t know what they told you to “Make” you disappear, but whatever it was, must be scary powerfull. He thought.



It took them a few more minutes then usual to go the alternate route, up the street and then through the alley next to the convenience store on the end of the block before they made it to the designated stop. The large yellow vehicle descended from the skyroad, making its way to the landing zone. It came to settle on the ground, alarms going off and a calm voice asking everyone to clear the immediate area. Lucas had heard it so often he didn’t even register it anymore, instead lining up with the rest of the kids and shuffling onto the bus once again, already wishing they were getting off instead.



Once the kids were settled the bus rose to the first sensor and waited to merge onto the skyway. Lucas stared out the window lost in thoughts over the argument this morning with pops, the old man was just trying to watch out for him, but dammit if he didn’t frustrate Lucas. The young platinum blonde child, for that is what Lucas still was, a child traced designs on the windows as he watched cars zip by between the sensors that made up the state’s skyway. Lucas had heard stories about asphalt roads that cut into the towns all over the place, must have been quite the eye sores he thought. He had only ever known the skyway, looking up and seeing the constant line of vehiles snake out into the distance was comforting, knowing that things in the country were working smoothly. “Hey, are you done your report” came a distinctly female voice from behind his seat and tearing him out of his thoughts. Turning he caught the bright blue hair of Allison Thompson, friend and study partner. Lucas smiled at her giving he his famous what me worry grin “of course, its going to be epic” he said , with more bravado then he felt. “Did you hear about Mrs Robinson?” Allison asked in a hushed tone, Even in talking about recent news there was a danger in being singled out , it had happened before where students had spread stories of things they had witnessed only to be brought into the principals office to be questioned by the authorities. It was always prudent, if you were going to talk about it , to ensure no one else heard it. Lucas just nodded as his eyes roved over the bus to ensure no one was paying too much attention to them. “Yeah Tommy and I watched it” he continued Sotto Voce. Allison nodded gravely and sat back in her chair. Lucas could see the event had bothered her. Mrs. Robinson had been a tutor for socio economics for a year and had single handledly helped Allison through that class. Lucas felt for her, no one like to see the reality of government paranoia wash up too close to home.



The began to descend towards the squat two story building that was the high school for his district in Arlington Virginia. Lucas could see the guards and detectors set up our front as they were every morning as the bus proceeded to land in front of the school in what was called the “insecure” section. This allowed the kids to leave the bus, make there way through the checkpoint lines and into the school or the “secure” area as it was called. It took almost thirty minutes to pass through the checkpoints as security seemed extra tight, he hadn’t heard why and felt a bit annoyed as he hurried off to his first class, already running a bit late.



“Shit, Shit, Shit” he whispered as he approached the shut door to homeroom , he could see Mr. Garcia already at the board reviewing the schedule for today’s events, he hated being, Lucas opened the door quietly , wincing as it creaked , he could see all eyes quickly focus on him including those of the teacher “Mr Christian, glad you could make it” Mr. Garcia said annoyed over his bifocal reading glasses. Lucas smiled sheepishly and rushed to take his seat.



“Now, before I was rudely interrupted” Mr. Garcia stated with a pointed look at a very guilty looking Lucas. “Todays celebration marks the seventy fifth anniversary of New America, we will start the day with Mr. Christian and his history of New America, followed by America the Steadfast played by the highschool band, we will then have a special speaker followed by question and answers and then lunch” Mr. Garcia finished pointing at each item on the board. Lucas hadn’t been able to get past the one where he gave the history speech, its one he had been working on for weeks and was incredibly nervous about speaking.  In front of all his friends and fellow students. Lucas could feel sweat creeping in along his forehead. “Oh, come on, I don’t need this” he thought wiping away the offending perspiration.



Mr Garcia took the class through the rest of the day and thirty minutes later they were dismissed to take their places for the celebration. Lucas reported to the auditorium. He walked in the double doors to already find Tommy setting up the holo screen with the pictures and Allison testing the audio equipment. Smiling he walked over to his friends. “How we doing?” he asked feeling a bit useless as all the big items had been or were being completed.



Allison pushed the offending blue strands of hair out of her face, her green eyes flashing a bit of annoyance at the mop on her head. “fine, the auditor should be here soon to review the presentation, she might be running late, but nothing we can do” she said shrugging at her friend.



Lucas shook his head, of course she was. Every presentation needed the approval of the government auditor before it could be broadcast to ensure that anything said could not come across as unpatriotic, to present anything that had not been approved could get you thrown in jail, or worse. “We will wait, let me know when she is here” Lucas said, making his way across the stage to thd rats’ nest of wires where his friend was cursing at the small screen in front of him. Tommy had a tablet resting against his ample stomach as he watched the preview holo file, everyone once in a while he would tweak a wire or type something into the main computer. “What are you doing?” Lucas asked with a smile shaking his head at his large gawky friend. “The videos aren’t syncing with the timing I need, if you tried to use it now it wouldn’t que to your presentation and just look stupid” he said continuing to concentrate on the holo screen and the computer. Lucas didn’t begin to understand and trusted that Tommy, president of the AV club and geek extroidonaire would be able to get it fixed in time.



It took Tommy nearly a half hour until he was satisfied with his setup. “Are we ready man?” Lucas asked with mild annoyancve, his friend was a bit of a perfectionist and it had more then onced caused Lucas to roil with impatience. “Lucas, your needed” Allison called from the side of the stage, interrupting the conversation he was about to have. Turning he could see a short stocky man with thick glasses standing at the edge of the stage, he didn’t look happy, causing alarm bells to go off in Lucas’s head. This must be the auditor he thought , walking over to greet the little man. “I am Mister Snieder, you can call me sir, I am here to audit your presentation for malicious and unpatriotic content for the school” he simply stated, already Lucas not liking the little man “Okay, sir, please feel free do to so” Lucas said neutrally as he stepped aside giving the man a view of Tommy and the crack of his ass , as the young man finished cursing at a set of wires. Mister Snieder looked over disapprovingly but continued over to here Tommy was. They began speaking quietly and Lucas focused his attention on Allison. “Not a very friendly guy, is he?” Lucas whispered illiciting a serious nod from Allison. “hey, this needs to go well, I once saw an auditor code red a presentation and the kid spent a week in interrogation because of something stupid he had put in it, so take this seriously” she hissed at him.



Lucas sobered a bit and then looked over at the man in a new light, for the first time that Lucas could remember he felt a little bit of fear and paranoia creep into his mind.



It took two agonizing hours for Mister Sneider to review the presentation and with a couple, of small notes deemed it worthy to be presented. Lucas sighed heavily as he had spent the last two hours with mental reels of special forces descending from the roof to arrest him for something he had missed in his report. Mister Snieder nodded without another word, signed something on his tablet that he transmitted to the principal and then was off, leaving the three students alone in the auditorium.



“Thirty minutes till curtain” Allison stated watching the little man walk out of the big double doors.



They spent the next half an hour watching students and teachers shuffle into the auditorium, Lucas watched the crowd intently looking for his father, who still had not shown up. “He will be here” Tommy said with conviction though Tommy’s own father was an ass and tended to miss every school activity, Lucas knew his father wouldn’t miss it for the world. “I know man, just jitters, I hate speaking in front of a crowd” he said to his friend clapping him on the back. Tommy smiled at him and then walked towards the back of the stage presumably to ensure everything was still working smoothly Perfectionist Lucas thought shaking his head.



Looking out over the full crowd of student, teachers and parents Lucas looked again for his father and didn’t see him, the butterflies were threatening to break out of his stomach as he thought about the number of people out in the audience, squinting from the bright spotlights that now shown on him he took a breath. “Just concentrate on the presentation, don’t think about the people” he whispered to himself.



The lights lowered and the spotlight descended to shine directly on him. Lucas took a moment to get his bearings, playing with the tablet as he organized his thoughts, adjusting the mic on his lapel he could hear the rustling through the speakers and winced.



He quickly mumbled an apology which illicited a quiet laugh from the audience. Lucas wiped his palms on his slacks No pressure, just my ability to graduate on the line he thought and focused his attention on the screen where the lines of text spelled out the history of New America.



“Seventy five years ago, the old United States was rife with a political body that was elected by the people, this political body was rife with corruption and dishonesty, many of those serving under this broken government were ill prepared or with no experience, the only qualification was they were able to shock there constituents enough with stories of there competitors antics that they themselves received the votes to put them in office. Worse still foreign governments with the help of a few key people devoid of conscience sought to destabilize the country further by rigging elections to ensure that candidates who would do there bidding, or worse cause chaos in the already broken system rose to power.” Lucas, paused to look over the room, over the spotlight it was hard to see, but at least they weren’t boo’ing he thought.



He took a breath and continued. “These politicians propogated a broken system, passing unrealistic laws and holding yearly budgets hostage to try and coorce unrealistic campaign promises from there peers. At the end the citizens of this country realized they were the ones who suffered and just as the country was about to collapse from financial and moral ruin. The country was struck with the BioPlague. Retribution for the countries ego at trying to police the world. Over half the population was destroyed, the broken and corrupt government of the country fled to bunkers to save themselves, sending edicts and orders that made less and less sense as those left above were forced to deal with the reality of the collapse. The country was financially destiture, people were starving, and foreign governments moved to take advantage of the power vacuum left after the collapse. And yet these government officials holed up in there protected bunkers thought themselves still in control, then within a decade the various factions in these bunkers began to squabble over who would lead the new government spawning the second great civil war”  Lucas took a breath and scanned the room again to see , to his surprised people leaning forward, interested in the presentation. He took a quick glance behind him to see the large two-story pictures of the devastation of the civil war as Tommy kept the pictures in sync with his speech. Lucas nodded at his friend and continued.

“Over a quarter of the survivors died fighting each other so that these twisted politicians could try and sieze power from one another. After another year the people of this country had enough.



It was at that time the corporations emerged, the four saviors of our land banded together to bring this country back to greatness.” Lucas stated, pausing for dramatic effect and eyeing the screen as the logos for the corporations appeared on the large screen.



EnviroCorp, Black Dragon LLC, Polyhedron and DynaTech the heads of these companies began to reassemble a new society from the ashes of the old one. Disbanding the old archaic democracy, disbanding the congress , they created a simple government called “The Board” run by the four heads of the companies they divided responsibilities among these four companies, taking over the remains of all other corporate entities left in the nation and organizing them the four corporations becoming the backbone of this great country Polyhedron organized all biotech, Pharacuetical and hospitals under the Department of Health, DynaTech took over all finance, banks and investment companies organizing them under the Department of Finance, Black Dragon took over all military, military contractor and defense contractors under the Department of Security and EnviroCorp took over all  farms farm companies and all farmland in the country , organizing them under the Department of Agriculture.



Then the board brought to justice those who had saved themselves in the protected bunkers.” Lucas turned to see the video of the public execution of the six remaining senators of the old United States, the board made up of Roger Etheron of Envirocorp, Bruce McDermot of Black Dragon, Anna Domingez of Polyhedron and Justin Blackwell of DynaTech, the founders of there society, standing tall and proud as they dispensed justice to these icons of the old world. As soon as the video finished, applause erupted in the room causing Lucas to smile, oh yes, he was going to pass he thought. Shooting a glance to both Allison and Tommy who shot him thumbs up.  Lucas scanned the crowd as the harsh spotlights subsided and his face fell realizing his father wasn’t there.



Tommy looked between the audience and his friend, the look on his friends face finally registering, he walked over and clapped his friend on the shoulder “he probably got busy, that’s all” he said trying to comfort Lucas.



For his part Lucas shrugged and put on a fake smile “your right” they made there bows and quickly departed the stage to an excited Allison “that was awesome” she yelled throwing her arms around both them them, giving Lucas a face full of blue hair. They talked for an hour about the possibilities of college and the score they would get on the report, once the teacher turned in the grade.



Lucas found himself alone on the street an hour later walking back to his house, Both Tommy and Allison had stayed, he had begged off, worried about his dad, it wasn’t like his father to miss anything school related and the longer he didn’t hear from him the more worried he got.



He knew something was wrong as he rounded the corner a block from his house, noticing the strobing blue lights bouncing off the houses at the end of the street. Lucas felt his blood run cold as he picked up the pace, trying in vain to see where the sirens were coming from. After two driveways he found himself in a full out run, the lights getting brighter the closer he got. As he rounded the end of the street he could see the black vans surrounding his small house with the men in black tachtical gear walked in and out of the front door. Lucas sprinted towards the house and was almost tackled by a man in a riot helmet sporting a large shotgun “Slow down kid, where the hell do you think you are going?” he asked stepping in front of the much smaller Lucas. “Where is my dad” he asked in a near panic, trying to get a look over the other mans considerable shoulder towards the house. “Whats your name young man” the officer asked, his voice getting an air of coldness.



Lucas ignored the warning in the voice and told him his name. Before he could even blink two of the other officers were on him, slamming him to the pavement and he felt the bite as plastic cuffs were placed on his wrists “What the hell man” he huffed out , it was hard to breathe with the two men’s knees on his back. The first soldier leaned down and took a picture of him and then leaned closer still “Lucas Christian, you are under arrest for treason against the New American Government” and before he could protest a Blackness covered his world as someone put a hood over his head.
